stories.title: Final objection window opens on Flintshire Catholic super-school plans
stories.summary: Objections to the £55 million Flint 3-18 school must be received by 5pm on December 8, with four existing Catholic schools set to close.

stories.title: Why 250 council homes are empty while 531 people in Flintshire wait in temporary housing
stories.summary: Flintshire Council has about 250 empty homes on its books while 531 people are living in temporary accommodation, councillors have been told. Councillor Kevin Rush (Bagillt, Labour) told the Community and Housing Overview and Scrutiny Committee today, Wednesday 11 November, that officers had given him the figure of 250 before the meeting. stories.summary: A senior officer told councillors there is no dog warden at the council, but the updated enforcement policy still says the Dog Warden will collect strays. Flintshire County Council no longer has a dog warden, a senior officer has told councillors. stories.title: Pensioners warned about fake Winter Fuel Payment texts asking for bank details
stories.summary: Pensioners are being warned about fake Winter Fuel Payment texts as the payments start to arrive. Most eligible people do not need to apply and will be paid automatically in November or December, according to GOV.UK.
